print-view.description: Ink-safe print stylesheets and a print preview for month and agenda exports.

examples.note: Use the browser print dialog to export a PDF. Toolbars and side panels hide automatically; scrollers expand and shadows flatten.

installation.note: No extra install — print CSS ships with the calendar shell and views.

props.note: Month prints the 6x7 grid; narrow viewports print the schedule agenda via the shell fallback.

print-view.title: Calendar Print
